verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents 'many SDKs' alongside its REST and GraphQL APIs. Its CLI `generate` command builds a type-safe SDK tailored to the project's schema, and service docs reference SDK methods (e.g. Messaging's createEmail/createSms/createPush, SDK-triggered Functions). For AI-native use, it ships open-source Skills and an MCP server that give agents current SDK context so they make SDK-accurate calls. Missing for 10: an explicit enumeration of supported SDK languages/platforms in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
